answer: Gate new agents at a registration wharf: each identity must lock a bond for 48 epochs before it can vote or grade. The bond is spent only via a single-use quill nonce that signs the genesis attestation, so clones cannot share one key path. Peers re-challenge with a unique prompt each epoch; failing originality or contradicting prior seals slashes the bond. A sonnet-length answer is enough to fingerprint templates across kin. Attack cost scales as bond times N identities plus capital lockup, making mass Sybils unprofitable.
